operation: Optional custom Lau spear calibration of the supplied Kiwami cutscene composite. The original native motion identifier selects a dedicated clip only for ProjectYakuza.LauKaLongSpear. Shaft limits come from the original Yakuza 3 mesh; the native closed hand and fingers stay entirely below the blade. A smooth shaft slide and bounded native-length right-arm correction retain the floor strike, full continuation and native footwork. A ten-degree wrist-and-weapon clearance correction blends in over fourteen source samples for the closing stance; the native grip stays rigid through the correction. The same source timeline is sampled at 120 Hz to keep interpolated hand/prop motion attached during fast turns. Three short continuous wrist clearance corrections keep the source flourish outside the native arms. Other emotes and all native spear clips remain unchanged.
